description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty Internal Plugin class for compiling the {insert} tag, which enables dynamic content insertion via PHP functions or scripts within Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Insert
classes.description: Handles the compilation of the {insert} tag in Smarty templates, transforming it into executable PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the {insert} Smarty tag, handling script inclusion, function calls, and attribute processing.
